# REEFIYA LLC (ريفيا) — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Context
> Website: https://reefiya.com | Arabic: https://reefiya.com/ar | RFQ Portal: https://reefiya.com/rfq
> Industry: Sweet potato export: fresh, industrial bulk and frozen programmes
> Operations hub: Alexandria, Egypt · Commercial presence: Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), United States (registered LLC), Canada (federally incorporated)
> Primary produce: Egyptian sweet potatoes (Ipomoea batatas)
> Source: Reefiya Export Catalogue 2026 — https://reefiya.com/downloads/reefiya-export-catalogue-2026.pdf

## Company
- **Legal entity:** Reefiya LLC (شركة ريفيا للحاصلات الزراعية والتصدير)
- **Brand names:** REEFIYA, ريفيا
- **Focus:** One crop, fully focused. Sweet potatoes are Reefiya's primary export crop; every order is built around the buyer's specification, destination market and packing requirements.
- **Operations:** The Alexandria base coordinates sourcing, grading, packing and dispatch. Commercial offices in Riyadh, the United States and Canada support contracting and cross-border communication.
- **Key figures:** 15+ export markets · 4 countries of presence · commercial replies within 1–2 business days.
- **Quality & compliance:** GLOBALG.A.P. · ISO 22000 · Egyptian Plant Quarantine.
- **Contact:** exports@reefiya.com · Phone/WhatsApp +20 12 9009 9230 · 144 Port Said St, El Ibrahimaia Bahry, Alexandria, Egypt
- **Social:** linkedin.com/company/reefiyaexports · instagram.com/reefiyaexports

## Fresh varieties
1. **Bellevue (بيلفيو) — fresh market**
   - Profile: smooth, uniform skin · sweet taste
   - Use: fresh market · retail chains · wholesale terminals · foodservice
   - Page: https://reefiya.com/varieties/bellevue
2. **Beauregard (بوريجارد) — export variety**
   - Profile: rich orange flesh · high yield; a widely traded commercial variety
   - Use: export · retail · wholesale · processing
   - Page: https://reefiya.com/varieties/beauregard
3. **Egyptian varieties (الأصناف المصرية) — seasonal selection**
   - Profile: robust local character · high sugar; traditional local varieties
   - Use: fresh market · seasonal programmes
   - Availability: seasonal, confirm at enquiry
   - Page: https://reefiya.com/varieties/egyptian

All varieties: sizes S–XL / Jumbo · cartons, crates, mesh bags, bulk bins · private label available.

## Grading & calibration (weight per root)
- **S:** 100–150 g · small, retail packs, mixed programmes
- **M:** 150–300 g · medium, most common retail size
- **L1:** 300–450 g · large
- **L2:** 450–600 g · large
- **XL / Jumbo:** 600 g + · extra-large, foodservice trade
- Custom grading, calibrated sizing and buyer-specific specifications are available as part of custom programmes.

## Industrial programme
- Fresh whole sweet potatoes for food factories and production lines; industrial bulk and seasonal programmes.
- Size and grade agreed per buyer.
- Supply format: strapped bulk pallet bins, loaded on pallets for reefer shipment.
- Page: https://reefiya.com/products/industrial

## Frozen programme
- Frozen sweet potato cubes (1 kg pack) and battered sweet potato fries (5/16″, 1.13 kg pack), packed under the Reefiya label.
- Keep frozen at −18 °C. Specifications and pack sizes agreed per buyer.
- Page: https://reefiya.com/products/frozen

## Packhouse
- Every root passes through brush washing, rinsing and mechanical sorting before it is graded to size and packed to the buyer's specification.

## Packaging
- Ventilated corrugated export carton · heavy-duty wooden export crate · mesh bag (retail packs) · reusable ventilated plastic crate · bulk pallet bin (industrial volumes).
- Net weights set to the buyer's requirement; Reefiya recommends a packing solution on request.
- Option 1: Reefiya export packaging (ready-to-ship Reefiya-branded cartons, crates and mesh bags).
- Option 2: Private label (cartons, bags and labels printed to the buyer's design).

## Loading & shipping
- Container: 40 ft reefer · ≈ 21,600 kg reference load.
- Terms: FOB · CFR · CIF, subject to quotation.
- Documents: prepared per destination market.
- Refrigerated shipping with controlled temperature and airflow throughout international transit.

## Export journey
Sourcing → Grading → Packing → Reefer → Dispatch.
